sessions.title: Course Introduction & C++ Review
sessions.objective: Understand the course goals, review basic C++ and the concept of pointers

sessions.title: Arrays & Pointers, Dynamic Allocation
sessions.objective: Work with arrays and pointers; allocate and free dynamic memory

sessions.title: Algorithm Complexity Analysis
sessions.objective: Understand and compute the Big-O complexity of simple code

sessions.title: Singly Linked Lists
sessions.objective: Implement insertion, deletion and search on a singly linked list

sessions.title: Doubly & Circular Linked Lists
sessions.objective: Distinguish and implement doubly and circular linked lists

sessions.title: Stack
sessions.objective: Understand LIFO, implement a stack and its applications (balanced parentheses, postfix expressions)

sessions.title: Queue
sessions.objective: Understand FIFO, implement a queue and a circular queue, and their applications

sessions.title: Recursion
sessions.objective: Identify the base case and recursive step, and analyze the cost of recursion

sessions.title: Sorting
sessions.objective: Compare sorting algorithms (selection, insertion, merge, quick) by complexity

sessions.title: Trees & Binary Trees
sessions.objective: Learn tree terminology and the preorder, inorder and postorder traversals

sessions.title: Binary Search Trees (BST)
sessions.objective: Implement insertion, deletion and search on a BST and understand the degenerate case

sessions.title: AVL Trees
sessions.objective: Understand the AVL balance condition and perform rotations

sessions.title: Heaps & Priority Queues
sessions.objective: Implement a heap with an array, insertion, removing the root, and heap sort

sessions.title: Graphs
sessions.objective: Represent graphs (adjacency matrix, adjacency list) and traverse them with BFS and DFS

sessions.title: Hash Tables & Review
sessions.objective: Understand hash functions, collisions and how to resolve them; review the whole course
